A darbar fit for every occasion

Step off the highway into an elegant dining room built for long, unhurried meals. Kishangarh Darbar has become the town's go-to table for family dinners, celebrations and the traveller who wants a proper Rajasthani thali instead of roadside fast food.

Our kitchen cooks the way Rajasthan always has, with smoke, slow fire and generous hands. Guests also love the Indian, Chinese and Italian dishes that keep the whole table happy.
